title: Authenticated commands: tamper, replay, wrong key, expiry, authorization
summary: All links up. Mission Control (Endpoint B) sends 25 commands 1.5 s apart, signed with the demo TEST KEYS (Ed25519 suite 0xFF02 unless noted, HMAC-SHA-256 suite 0xFF01 where noted): valid commands, commands altered after signing (command byte, priority, TTL, Timestamp, security_sequence, Authority Context, CRC, MUX frame_count lowered to 1 and to 0), byte-identical replays, commands signed with keys the rover does not hold, an unknown key_id, an expired command, unauthorized and authorized roles, a wrong policy epoch, a validly signed command naming an authority the rover policy does not know, an unsigned command, a command without Authority Context, and a protected command carrying an unknown frame type. The rover (Endpoint A) verifies each one per PBS-SEC-B-01 and PBS-AUTH-01 and logs its disposition; tampering is applied by Endpoint B before the envelope is handed to ION and stands for modification in transit.

criteria.text: Each command gets the expected disposition at the rover
Only the five accepted commands are executed (logged), in order
Every command envelope handed to ION is received at the rover
The rover receives the bytes Endpoint B handed to ION (tampered bytes included)
Every recv record (audit line) matches an envelope that was sent; no duplicates
Rover telemetry and the PING reply continue to arrive and are accepted
No receiver accepts an envelope older than its TTL

criteria.label: S6-21-VALID-AFTER-REJECTS
criteria.text: A valid command sent after the rejected ones is accepted; the measured value gives the number of envelopes the rover rejected before it

conformance.how: modifications tested, each rejected: command byte, priority, TTL, Timestamp, security_sequence and Authority Context altered after signing (SEC_AUTH_FAIL, S6-03 to S6-08); CRC32 field altered (CRC, S6-20); MUX frame_count lowered to 1 and to 0 (SEC_MISSING, S6-23, S6-24); signatures by keys the rover does not hold (SEC_AUTH_FAIL, S6-11, S6-12)
byte-identical replays rejected with SEC_REPLAY (S6-09, S6-10)
unauthorized role (S6-15), wrong policy epoch (S6-17) and an authority the rover policy does not know in a validly signed command (S6-25) rejected with AUTHZ_DENIED; authorized role accepted (S6-16)
expired command rejected with TTL_EXPIRED before authentication (S6-14)
unknown frame type inside a protected command skipped and covered by authentication (S6-22)
one recv audit record per command with reason code, one exec record per executed command (S6-2, S6-5)
a valid command sent after the rejected ones is accepted; S6-8 gives the number of rejections before it, counted from the rover's log
